jobs.description:
Bräcker AG, weltweit führender Anbieter von Ringen und Ringläufern für Ringspinnmaschinen, ist eine Tochtergesellschaft des Rieter-Konzerns. Mit Hauptsitz im schweizerischen Pfäffikon bietet Bräcker Mehrwert für seine Kunden mit hoch entwickeltem Branchenwissen, innovativen Lösungen, ausgezeichneten Leistungen im After-Sales-Bereich und einer globalen Präsenz. Die Hauptprodukte des Unternehmens – Ringe und Ringläufer für Ringspinnmaschinen – werden in Pfäffikon und Wintzenheim (Frankreich) hergestellt. Das Produktspektrum des Unternehmens beinhaltet ferner Schleifmaschinen für die Wartung von Walzenbezügen.

Für unser Team im Verkaufsinnendienst suchen wir eine offene, humorvolle und initiative Persönlichkeit als

Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

• Technische und kommerzielle Klärung von Offerten und Aufträgen

• Preis- und Terminbestimmungen anhand Unterlagen und in Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stellen (Lager, Produktionsplanung)

• Offertstellung und Auftragsabwicklung inkl. Versand/Export

• Terminüberwachung der Aufträge und der nötigen Freigabe-Dokumente wie Importlizenzen, Akkreditive etc.

• Versand der Aufträge auf dem Luft-, See- und Landweg mit Erstellung der Rechnungen und sämtlicher Exportpapiere unter Beachtung allfälliger L/C-, CAD- oder anderen Vorschriften

• Schriftliche und telefonische Kontakte mit Spediteuren, Kontrollstellen, Handelskammer, Konsulaten, Banken

• Bemusterungen

• Nachfassen von Offerten

• Zahlungserinnerungen an Kunden

Ihr Anforderungsprofil

• Kaufmännische Grundausbildung; Weiterbildung im Bereich Export von Vorteil

• Erfahrung in der Auftragsbearbeitung und Export in einem Industriebetrieb

• Gute SAP-Kenntnisse (SD Modul) & MS Office-Kenntnisse

• Gute Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch, weitere Sprachen von Vorteil

• Kundenorientiertes Verhalten

Unsere Versprechen

• Die Mitarbeit in einem führenden Unternehmen

• Eine vielseitige Tätigkeit mit Raum zur Eigeninitiative

• Faire Anstellungsbedingungen und ein angenehmes Arbeitsklima

• Die Möglichkeit teilweise im Home-Office zu arbeiten

Wenn Sie Freude an einer selbständigen Tätigkeit haben und gerne in einem internationalen Umfeld arbeiten, dann erwartet Frau Carmela Greter gerne Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen per E-Mail. Direktbewerbungen werden bevorzugt.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Bräcker AG, the world’s leading supplier of rings and ring travelers for ring spinning machines, is a subsidiary of the Rieter Group. Headquartered in Pfäffikon, Switzerland, Bräcker offers added value to its customers with highly developed industry knowledge, innovative solutions, excellent after-sales services and a global presence. The company’s main products – rings and ring travelers for ring spinning machines – are manufactured in Pfäffikon and Wintzenheim (France). The company’s product range also includes grinding machines for the maintenance of roll covers. For our sales team we are looking for an open, humorous and initiative personality as Your main tasks and responsibilities
• Technical and commercial clarification of offers and orders
• Pricing and deadlines based on documents and in cooperation with internal bodies (stocks, production planning)
• Offering and order processing incl. Shipping/export
• Schedule monitoring of orders and the necessary release documents such as import licenses, letters of credit etc.
• Dispatch of orders by air, sea and land with preparation of invoices and all export documents in compliance with any L/C, CAD or other regulations
• Written and telephone contacts with forwarders, control bodies, chambers of commerce, consulates, banks
• Samples
• Replication of offers
• Payment reminders to customers Your requirement profile
• Basic commercial training; Export training is an advantage
• Experience in order processing and export in an industrial company
• Good SAP knowledge (SD module) & MS Office knowledge
• Good language skills in English, other languages beneficial
• Customer-oriented behaviour Our promises
• Working in a leading company
• A versatile activity with space for own initiative
• Fair employment conditions and a pleasant working environment
• The possibility to work partially in the home office If you enjoy self-employment and would like to work in an international environment, then Mrs. Carmela Greter is happy to expect your application documents by e-mail. Direct applications are preferred. Area: Administration Level: Experienced professionals

jobs.title: Product Manager Automation
jobs.description:
Rieter is the world’s leading system supplier for processing natural and man-made fibers into short-staple and long-staple yarn, as well as for the production of filament yarns, man-made fibers and nonwovens. With its comprehensive technology portfolio, Rieter covers the entire textile value chain – from fiber to yarn, and from polymer melt to texturized filament, synthetic staple fibers and nonwoven. Headquartered in Winterthur, Switzerland, the company designs and engineers complex spinning plants, machines, systems, and components that enable an efficient and economical production. Rieter’s leading technologies ensure minimal resource consumption, making a significant contribution to sustainability across the global textile value chain. Rieter has a history spanning more than 230 years, operates 17 production sites in nine countries, and employs around 4 220 people worldwide, approximately 15.4% of them in Switzerland. Rieter is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange under the ticker symbol RIEN.

You have power, are versatile, service- and goal-oriented? You like to work in a team, are curious and always find innovative ways to reach your goals? Then you fit perfectly within our team and can strengthen our business as

Your Tasks

• Take an active role in technical sales, supporting the global sales organization in value‑based selling, solution definition, and technical‑commercial clarification in complex customer-specific automation and system projects

• Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for automation systems towards the fully automated spinning mill

• Identify market trends and customer requirements and translate them into competitive automation solutions

• Conduct and maintain market and competitor analyses to support portfolio and investment decisions

• Act as Product Owner (PLM) for automation products, engineered solutions, spare parts, and repair offerings across the full lifecycle

• Ensure close collaboration with R&D, engineering, operations, sales, and service to deliver customer‑focused solutions

Your Qualifications

• Minimum 5 years of experience in B2B technical sales, product management, or solution engineering for automation systems (e.g. AGVs, cobots, palletizing solutions)

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Automation, Electrical or Mechatronics Engineering

• Experience in the textile industry is an advantage

• Strong analytical, communication, and decision-making skills with the ability to align cross-functional teams

• Willingness for global travel

• Openess to other cultures

• Fluent in English and German

Our Offer

• an international working environment with long tradition

• versatile activity in a future-oriented environment with a lot of self-responsibility

• good development opportunities and fair employment conditions

• a motivated team with mutual respect and good cooperation

Are you interested? If you recognize yourself in this profile and you would like to be part of a successful team, we look forward to meeting you soon. Please send us your complete application documents online.

Bereich: R&D, Engineering

Level: Professionals

descriptionByLocale.it:
Rieter è il fornitore leader mondiale di sistema per la lavorazione di fibre naturali e artificiali in filati a breve e a lungo raggio, così come per la produzione di filati di filamento, fibre artificiali e non tessuti. Con il suo portafoglio tecnologico completo, Rieter copre l'intera catena del valore tessile – dalla fibra al filato, e dal polimero sciolto al filamento testurizzato, fibre sintetiche e non tessuto. Con sede a Winterthur, in Svizzera, la società progetta e progetta impianti di filatura complessi, macchine, sistemi e componenti che consentono una produzione efficiente ed economica. Le principali tecnologie di Rieter garantiscono un consumo minimo di risorse, dando un contributo significativo alla sostenibilità in tutta la catena globale del valore tessile. Rieter ha una storia che dura più di 230 anni, gestisce 17 siti produttivi in nove paesi, e impiega circa 4 220 persone in tutto il mondo, circa il 15,4% di loro in Svizzera. Rieter è quotata sulla SIX Swiss Exchange sotto il simbolo RIEN. Hai il potere, sei versatile, orientato al servizio e all'obiettivo? Ti piace lavorare in un team, sei curioso e sempre trovare modi innovativi per raggiungere i tuoi obiettivi? Poi si adatta perfettamente all'interno del nostro team e può rafforzare il nostro business come I vostri compiti
• Assumere un ruolo attivo nelle vendite tecniche, sostenendo l'organizzazione globale delle vendite nella vendita basata sul valore, nella definizione delle soluzioni e nella chiarificazione tecnico-commerciale in complessi progetti di automazione e sistema specifici per i clienti
• Definire e guidare la visione del prodotto, la strategia e la roadmap per i sistemi di automazione verso la filatura completamente automatizzata
• Identificare le tendenze del mercato e i requisiti dei clienti e tradurli in soluzioni di automazione competitiva
• Condurre e mantenere analisi di mercato e concorrenti per sostenere le decisioni di portafoglio e di investimento
• Atto come Product Owner (PLM) per prodotti di automazione, soluzioni ingegnerizzate, pezzi di ricambio e offerte di riparazione in tutto il ciclo di vita
• Garantire una stretta collaborazione con R&D, ingegneria, operazioni, vendite e assistenza per fornire soluzioni orientate al cliente Le tue qualifiche
• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nelle vendite tecniche B2B, nella gestione dei prodotti o nell'ingegneria delle soluzioni per sistemi di automazione (ad esempio AGV, cobot, soluzioni di palletizzazione)
• Laurea o Master in automazione, ingegneria elettrica o meccatronica
• L'esperienza nell'industria tessile è un vantaggio
• Forte capacità analitiche, comunicative e decisionali con la capacità di allineare i team interfunzionali
• Volontà per i viaggi globali
• Apertura ad altre culture
• Fluente in inglese e tedesco La nostra offerta
• un ambiente di lavoro internazionale con una lunga tradizione
• attività versatile in un ambiente orientato al futuro con un sacco di responsabilità
• buone opportunità di sviluppo e condizioni di lavoro eque
• un team motivato con rispetto reciproco e buona cooperazione Sei interessato? Se ti riconosci in questo profilo e ti piacerebbe essere parte di una squadra di successo, non vediamo l'ora di incontrarti presto. Vi preghiamo di inviarci i vostri documenti di applicazione completi online. Bereich: R&D, Engineering Livello: Professionisti

Rieter is the world’s leading system supplier for processing natural and man-made fibers into short-staple and long-staple yarn, as well as for the production of filament yarns, man-made fibers and nonwovens. With its comprehensive technology portfolio, Rieter covers the entire textile value chain – from fiber to yarn, and from polymer melt to texturized filament, synthetic staple fibers and nonwoven. Headquartered in Winterthur, Switzerland, the company designs and engineers complex spinning plants, machines, systems, and components that enable an efficient and economical production. Rieter’s leading technologies ensure minimal resource consumption, making a significant contribution to sustainability across the global textile value chain. Rieter is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange under the ticker symbol RIEN.

In this role, you will be part of the global CAD/PLM team and play a key role in maintaining and further developing the CAD/PLM system landscape. You will ensure smooth system operations, provide user support and contribute to continuous improvements of engineering processes.

The position combines technical expertise in CAD, PLM, and SAP with strong problem-solving skills and involves close collaboration with international stakeholders as well as support for ongoing S/4HANA initiatives.

Your Tasks

• Configure, optimize and further develop the CAD/PLM system landscape

• Take ownership of the PLM system environment, including client design and management

• Provide user support and conduct end-user training

• Solid knowledge of PLM systems, ideally including SAP ECTR and Pronovia products

• Advanced CAD skills, preferably in Siemens NX

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Rieter est le principal fournisseur mondial de systèmes pour la transformation des fibres naturelles et artificielles en fils à agrafes courtes et longues, ainsi que pour la production de fils de filaments, de fibres synthétiques ou artificielles et de nontissés. Avec son portefeuille technologique complet, Rieter couvre l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur textile – de la fibre au fil, de la fonte des polymères au filament texturé, aux fibres synthétiques discontinues et au non-tissés. Basée à Winterthur, en Suisse, l'entreprise conçoit et conçoit des installations de filature complexes, des machines, des systèmes et des composants qui permettent une production efficace et économique. Les technologies de pointe de Rieter assurent une consommation minimale de ressources, ce qui contribue grandement à la durabilité de la chaîne de valeur mondiale du textile. Rieter a une histoire de plus de 230 ans, exploite 17 sites de production dans neuf pays et emploie environ 4 220 personnes dans le monde, dont environ 15,4% en Suisse. Rieter est coté sur la SIX Swiss Exchange sous le symbole RIEN. Dans ce rôle, vous ferez partie de l'équipe mondiale CAD/PLM et jouerez un rôle clé dans le maintien et le développement du paysage du système CAD/PLM. Vous assurerez le bon fonctionnement du système, fournirez un soutien aux utilisateurs et contribuerez à l'amélioration continue des processus d'ingénierie. Le poste combine l'expertise technique en CAO, PLM et SAP avec de solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et implique une collaboration étroite avec les intervenants internationaux ainsi que le soutien pour les initiatives S/4HANA en cours. Vos tâches
• Configurer, optimiser et développer le paysage du système CAO/PLM
• Prise en charge de l'environnement du système PLM, y compris la conception et la gestion des clients
• Fournir un soutien aux utilisateurs et dispenser une formation aux utilisateurs finals
• Fournir un soutien de deuxième niveau pour les applications CAD/PLM
• Analyser et résoudre les problèmes techniques, en conduisant à des améliorations continues des processus
• Appuyer les activités du projet S/4HANA (intégration, essais et migration)
• Diplôme dans un domaine technique ou une qualification équivalente
• Connaissance solide des systèmes PLM, incluant idéalement les produits SAP ECTR et Pronovia
• Forte expertise SAP (PLM, DMS, SEAL)
• Compétences avancées en CAO, de préférence en Siemens NX
• Bonne compréhension des environnements Microsoft serveur/client, réseau et gestion des certificats
• Compétences de base en programmation (p. ex., Lot, PowerShell)
• Niveau élevé d'agilité et d'adaptabilité dans un environnement dynamique
• Connaissance de l'anglais (écrit et parlé)
• Idéalement 3+ ans d'expérience dans un rôle similaire
• Orientation forte du service, esprit d'équipe et réflexion analytique Notre offre
